automated.summary: All deterministic Forge checks pass at d4d3972: dual-runtime parity, scaffold integrity, and 270 automated tests. The suite includes four gate tests that were red when this story began — they were failing for a calendar-dependent reason inherited from FORGE-DELEG-1, diagnosed and fixed under quickfix Q-0005 as part of unblocking this story's own verify.
commands_run: FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD='python3 factory/scripts/check_dual_runtime.py' FACTORY_TYPECHECK_CMD='python3 factory/scripts/check_factory_scaffold.py' FACTORY_TEST_CMD='uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests -q' python3 factory/scripts/verify.py
uvx --with pytest python3 -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "upgrade or adopt"
uvx --with pytest python3 -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "migrate or stage_done or reaps or termination_signal or process_identity or process_cleanup"
tests_added_or_updated: test_upgrade_retires_the_legacy_agents_tree — a pre-rename target ends with no .agents/ and a complete factory/
test_upgrade_carries_legacy_skills_into_factory — proposed/rejected and client-added skills survive at factory/skills/
test_upgrade_refuses_an_unrecognized_path_under_agents — an unshipped path aborts and is named; nothing is deleted
test_upgrade_refuses_unrecognized_content_parked_under_a_cache_name — only .pyc is exempt, not any path under a __pycache__ directory
test_upgrade_retires_a_legacy_tree_carrying_pycache — real repos all carry bytecode, so the counterpart check must not abort on it
test_upgrade_refuses_a_symlinked_legacy_skills_root — a topology that cannot be traversed or merged is refused, not silently dropped
test_upgrade_preserves_a_legacy_skill_symlink_as_a_symlink — the keep/restore round trip must not materialize a link's referent
test_upgrade_refusal_leaves_the_target_untouched — the refusal's own repair ('delete it and re-run') must be runnable
test_upgrade_reports_stale_agents_references — project-owned files are named; archived evidence and untracked trees are not
test_upgrade_reports_a_migrated_client_skill_naming_the_old_tree — carried skills are untracked until staged, so ls-files alone would report 'none'
test_upgrade_reports_a_symlink_pointing_at_the_retired_root — .agents matched as a whole path component, not only with a trailing slash
test_stage_migrate_records_the_base_on_adopted_stages — a short sha resolves to the full one on active/done stages only
test_process_identity_matches_the_process_table_on_single_digit_days — simulated ps output, so it detects the padding bug every day rather than only on days 1-9
test_process_cleanup_reaps_known_process_when_discovery_fails — SIGTERM then SIGKILL still reach a known process, and incompleteness is still reported
automated.pass_fail_summary: 270 passed in 860.89s; structural and scaffold checks passed.
remaining_gaps: A client skill whose name the harness has since started shipping is still replaced rather than preserved under conflict — pre-existing and symmetric with the non-legacy branch, deferred as D-0002 with a revisit trigger.

On macOS, ps no longer exposes another process's environment (verified on 26.5.1), so a descendant that detaches into a new session AND outlives its parent cannot be discovered by token at all. The product-tree and protected-authority guards still fail closed on the consequence, so no gate is weakened; full containment remains D-0001's deferred container boundary.

A ledgered quickfix taken while a stage is open wedges that stage: stage done has no notion of quickfix-attributed paths and stage start has no --base to re-baseline honestly. Worked around here by re-recording the scope; it will recur.
